title: AtomEnvelope
description: Common envelope on every atom in the append-only store. Field names follow the substrate's constraints register (stated_*) and obligations register (made_*); see 00-substrate-snapshot.md. Nothing is mutated in place: a change is a new atom whose `supersedes` points at the old one.

made_by.description: agent-id or human-id; never inferred from identity (evidence rule 5)

about.description: the far-side artifact this atom describes: path, URL or issue id

terminal.description: true when the atom deliberately links to nothing (cross-referenced property)

last_read.description: set by the recall meter on a CONSULT by a non-author session
